source_state: uncommitted preparation authority, retained sampler/token charges and shared physical-storage registration
behavior: Preparation and direct prefill share one request-start gate, including independently constructed handles for one reservation. Prompt construction and binding are separate, sampler construction is one-use, failed stages cannot be retried, and concurrent cloned handles cannot bypass preparation.
Preparation checks the exact finite output allowance before claiming startup and binds the sampling configuration. Move-only stage permits retain charges independently through completion or failure.

Native sampler state, sampler snapshots, pending prompt copies, sampled token handles and copy/reseed recovery retain request charges. Sampling restoration preserves both old and newer charges. CPU and Metal ordinary/controlled runs produce matching per-device token sequences and escaped tokens keep charges after driver/session retirement.

The neutral working-memory pool atomically registers existing physical inventories and admits incremental requests against one capacity. Overlapping inventories and clones count each physical allocation once, inconsistent capacities reject, and failure neither partially charges the pool nor increases its peak.

Concurrent neutral registrations admit exactly the fitting unique payloads while deduplicating common backing. Storage and inference admission cannot both spend the same remaining capacity. Empty registrations and identity reuse after complete retirement preserve accounting.

MLX registrations retain native, host-transfer, checkpoint-source and immutable-byte owners. Certified CPU/Metal host-array aliases use physical identities; source and byte allocations use distinct namespaces. Unknown and conflicting inventories reject without evaluating lazy values.

Final native registration drop stages ordinary host cleanup. Physical roots and their charge survive a busy native runtime, and safe explicit cleanup releases physical owners before refunding the registration. Pool peaks never rewind.

Seven embedded prediction variants across three residency modes register target and prediction inventories independently against the exact merged capacity. Shared replacements add one physical charge. Hidden checkpoint paths cannot be reopened during registration; unknown lazy replacements reject; charges outlive executable destruction and release with registered owners.

The complete selected native session/recovery suite, nine target inventory configurations, checkpoint source contracts, runtime suite and portable facade/backend conformance pass; the backend checks without default features.
limits: This milestone does not complete public automatic native request admission or session/domain installation of registrations. Existing-storage registration is not permission to allocate new storage and does not prove future workspace costs.
Native preparation tests use synthetic request charges to validate authority and retention. They are not complete numerical upper-bound validation for native request peak allocation.

Active speculative lanes, observation resources, escaped raw logits, independent copy/branch admission and complete future workspace remain required. A copied request retains its one-use prefill authority rather than authorizing another branch.

Callers must retain registrations while their allocations belong to a managed domain, use consistent physical keys, and keep the fixed baseline disjoint. Future composition must avoid charging existing registered backing again as incremental request storage.
Native inventory and startup tests include CPU and Metal. The 21 family/residency registration configurations run on CPU; no new native multi-device distributed or CUDA run was performed.

One portable tokenizer/template test remains ignored because EREDU_LFM2_TOOL_CHECKPOINT is not configured. It requires no native backend. Earlier pinned Qwen numerical and peak records remain separate evidence.

Managed payload accounting excludes allocator caches, JIT, metadata not separately quoted, and other process/system memory. No new allocator/process peak measurements or released-checkpoint comparisons were performed.
The existing compact-unwind warning and currently unused inventory/quote helper warnings remain; production public admission composition is still pending.
